parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A linked list of nodes is used to store an ordered list of strings. Each node consists of data, a left pointer and a right pointer.

[[fig:f1]]

The linked list will be organised as a binary tree.

0 is used to represent a null pointer.

Complete the binary tree, including null pointers, to show how the data will be organised after the following strings have been added:

Aa, Mm, Ss, Xx

[[fig:f2]]

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A binary tree can be used to implement recursion.

Identify one feature of an algorithm that makes it beneficial to use recursion. Give one example of an application that could use a recursive algorithm.

figures.alt: A node divided into left pointer, data and right pointer fields, with Pp in the data field.
A binary tree diagram with a root pointer leading to a Pp node, which points to Gg on the left and Rr on the right; Gg points to Kk, and the Kk node has 0 in its left field.
